subject: AI 与科技日报 2026-11-18 · Daily AI & Tech Brief
headline_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋辞职、SEC调查启动，公司宣布退出中国；乌克兰重创克里米亚大桥
headline_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid SEC probe as firm exits China; Ukraine cripples Crimean Bridge

items.title_zh: 英伟达宣布退出中国市场，黄仁勋辞职后临时CEO表态
items.title_en: Nvidia exits China as interim CEO speaks after Huang's resignation
items.body_zh: 英伟达临时CEO表示公司将停止向中国销售芯片，这是黄仁勋上周辞职后的重大战略转向。公司同时重申开源AI战略不变，并计划收购Hugging Face。
items.body_en: Nvidia's interim CEO said the company is done selling chips to China, a major strategic shift following Jensen Huang's resignation last week. The firm also reaffirmed its open-source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face.

items.title_zh: 英伟达董事会：不会重新任命黄仁勋为CEO
items.title_en: Nvidia board says it won't reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
items.body_zh: 新任董事会主席Harvey Jones在财报电话会上表示，董事会一致接受黄仁勋的辞职，不打算让他回归。黄仁勋此前曾表示若董事会邀请，他“荣幸”回归。
items.body_en: New board chair Harvey Jones said on the earnings call that the board unanimously accepted Huang's resignation and does not intend to reinstate him. Huang had said he would be 'honoured' to return if asked.

items.title_zh: SEC据报调查英伟达，黄仁勋承认与疑似中国间谍有染
items.title_en: SEC reportedly probes Nvidia after Huang admits affair with alleged Chinese spy
items.body_zh: 《华尔街日报》报道，SEC已对英伟达展开调查，此前黄仁勋承认与一名疑似中国间谍的女性有婚外情。调查加剧了公司领导层动荡。
items.body_en: The Wall Street Journal reports the SEC has opened a probe into Nvidia after Huang admitted to an affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. The investigation adds to the leadership turmoil.

items.title_zh: 英伟达财报强劲，但领导层危机抢镜
items.title_en: Nvidia posts bumper results amid leadership crisis
items.body_zh: 英伟达周二公布强劲季度业绩，但市场关注点集中在黄仁勋辞职及公司退出中国计划上。临时CEO Colette Kress与董事会主席Harvey Jones首次共同主持电话会。
items.body_en: Nvidia reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday, but focus was on Huang's exit and the China exit plan. Interim CEO Colette Kress and board chair Harvey Jones led the call together for the first time.

items.title_zh: 李飞飞率队正式加入AMD，苏姿丰亲自欢迎
items.title_en: Fei-Fei Li's team officially joins AMD as Lisa Su welcomes them
items.body_zh: 并购完成后，李飞飞正式率队加入AMD，AMD CEO苏姿丰亲自表示欢迎。此举被视为AMD在AI人才争夺战中的重要布局。
items.body_en: Following the completion of the acquisition, Fei-Fei Li's team has officially joined AMD, with CEO Lisa Su personally welcoming them. The move is seen as a key AI talent play for AMD.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO在即，亚马逊与谷歌将合计持股近30%
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO set; Amazon and Google to own nearly 30% combined
items.body_zh: Anthropic即将IPO，亚马逊将持有略低于15%的股份，谷歌紧随其后持有近14%。两家科技巨头合计持股近30%，凸显AI竞赛中的资本绑定。
items.body_en: Ahead of Anthropic's IPO, Amazon will own just under 15% and Google nearly 14%, giving the two giants close to 30% combined. The stakes highlight deep capital ties in the AI race.

items.title_zh: 微软Ignite发布多款AI模型，覆盖语音、医疗与网络安全
items.title_en: Microsoft unveils AI models for voice, healthcare, and cybersecurity at Ignite
items.body_zh: 微软在Ignite 2026上发布首款语音对语音模型MAI Realtime 1，起价每分钟0.01美元。其医疗转录引擎MAI-Transcribe-2将多语言错误率降低约50%，已覆盖全美三分之一医师。
items.body_en: At Ignite 2026, Microsoft launched MAI Realtime 1, its first speech-to-speech model, starting at $0.01 per audio minute. Its medical transcription engine MAI-Transcribe-2 cuts multilingual error rates by about 50% and is used by a third of US physicians.

items.title_zh: AI助力发现Java重大安全漏洞
items.title_en: AI helps find major security bug in Java
items.body_zh: 《纽约时报》报道，AI工具协助发现了Java平台中的一个重大安全漏洞，该平台对互联网至关重要。这凸显了AI在网络安全防御中的双刃剑角色。
items.body_en: The New York Times reports that AI tools helped uncover a major security flaw in Java, a platform vital to the internet. The finding underscores AI's double-edged role in cybersecurity.

items.title_zh: 乌克兰重创克里米亚大桥，泽连斯基称“前所未有”
items.title_en: Ukraine cripples Crimean Bridge in 'unprecedented' attack, Zelensky says
items.body_zh: 乌克兰用导弹和无人机攻击了连接俄罗斯与被占领克里米亚的克里米亚大桥，导致部分桥段坍塌。泽连斯基称此次袭击“前所未有”，俄方称大桥是普京统治的象征。
items.body_en: Ukraine struck the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea with missiles and drones, causing a section to collapse. Zelensky called the attack 'unprecedented'; the bridge is a symbol of Putin's rule.

items.title_zh: 五个欧盟国家计划在卢旺达设立移民“返回中心”
items.title_en: Five EU states plan immigration 'return hubs' in Rwanda
items.body_zh: 德国、奥地利、荷兰、丹麦和希腊宣布计划在卢旺达设立试点中心，安置无权留在欧洲的人。该计划被批评为“严重的道德失败”，预计将面临法律挑战。
items.body_en: Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Denmark and Greece announced plans for a pilot centre in Rwanda for people with no legal right to stay in Europe. The scheme has been criticised as a 'grave moral failing' and is expected to face legal challenges.

items.title_zh: 俄罗斯军机坠毁，机上19人全部遇难
items.title_en: Russian military plane crashes, killing all 19 on board
items.body_zh: 俄罗斯国防部称，一架军机在克麦罗沃地区坠毁，初步判断原因为技术故障，机上19人无一生还。
items.body_en: A Russian military plane crashed in the Kemerovo region, killing all 19 people on board, according to the defence ministry. A technical malfunction is the preliminary cause.

quick_zh: 苹果服务大规模中断，Apple Pay、iCloud等受影响，公司称内部系统更新所致，已全部恢复。
Steam突发大规模服务故障，游戏下载、好友列表和云存档受影响，Downdetector收到近4.8万条报告。
谷歌紧急回应Gmail故障传闻，称服务运行正常，此前微软365和苹果服务接连宕机。
quick_en: Apple services suffered a major outage affecting Apple Pay and iCloud; the company blamed an internal system update and said all services have been restored.
Steam experienced a widespread outage affecting downloads, friends lists and cloud saves, with nearly 48,000 reports on Downdetector.
Google denied reports of a Gmail outage, saying the service was running normally, after Microsoft 365 and Apple services had disruptions.
